messages.content: Propose an ordered list of hypotheses from the registered IDs only. Choose model structures only; do not estimate numeric parameters. message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "The combined model achieves the lowest RMSE (0.008453) among all passing structures, indicating the best fit to the observed position deviations while maintaining all 10 usable observations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This structure yields the second-lowest RMSE (0.009152), suggesting that sensor bias combined with a speed step explains the data better than single-factor models or other pairs.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "With an RMSE of 0.010417, this combined model outperforms individual sensor bias and velocity offset models, supporting a joint contribution of both factors.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SPEED_STEP", "rationale": "As a single-factor model, SPEED_STEP achieves the lowest RMSE (0.010829), indicating that a step change in speed is a significant contributor to the observed deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "VELOCITY_OFFSET", "rationale": "VELOCITY_OFFSET has a low RMSE (0.013055), suggesting a constant velocity offset contributes to the position error, though less effectively than combined models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "SENSOR_BIAS yields an RMSE of 0.012756, indicating a constant sensor bias is present but insufficient alone to fully explain the observations compared to combined structures.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
